abstract: Extra-ovarian yolk sac tumor arising in the omentum is extremely rare. As yolk sac tumor originated from the omentum has been rarely reported, its clinical information is very limited. The authors encountered a case of yolk sac tumor originated from the omentum, and reported the case herein. A 32-year-old woman was presented with developed low abdominal distension for a month. Magnetic resonance imaging findings were suggestive of ovarian malignancy with ascites and peritoneal seeding nodules. Explorative laparotomy was performed and then the findings from frozen biopsy of omentum were suggestive of poorly differentiated tumor though whether it was primary or metastatic was uncertain. Thus, staging laparotomy were performed. Histopathology confirmed that the tumor was a yolk sac tumor of omentum origin. Then, 6 cycles of postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy at intervals of 3 weeks were performed using bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin regimen. Four-year outpatient follow-up thereafter showed no relapse.
abstract_ja: 大網から生じる卵巣外の卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれである。大網由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告は少なく、臨床情報は非常に限られている。今回、大網原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍症例を経験したので報告する。32歳女性が1か月前からの下腹部膨満を主訴に受診した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見では、腹水および腹膜播種結節を伴う卵巣悪性腫瘍が示唆された。試験開腹術を行い、大網の凍結切片による生検の所見は未分化な腫瘍を示唆したが、原発性か転移性かは不明であった。そこで病期分類のための開腹術を行った。病理組織学により、大網由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定した。その後、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによるレジメンで、3週間間隔の術後補助化学療法を6サイクル実施した。4年間の外来フォローアップでは再発は認められなかった。
